name: Municipal Optics
levels: Environment Analysis: highlights everything you can use.
X-Ray: walls become a suggestion.
desc: Prescribed for a mild myopia of -0.75. The Council's optician was feeling generous, and the budget had to be spent before December.

name: Council Acoustics
levels: Eavesdrop on conversations from a distance.
Hear footsteps behind walls, marked on the terminal.
desc: Originally meant to follow council meetings from the back row. Now picks up gossip from three bars away. The gossip is mostly about you.

name: Titanium Spine
levels: Lift crates, bins and the occasional scooter.
Lift very heavy objects straight into the inventory.
desc: Replaces the lumbar vertebrae Alfonso had been complaining about since 2071. Installed under Council Resolution 451/2089, 'Measures for the ergonomic wellbeing of municipal staff'. Posture now comparable to a ministry building.

name: Hydraulic Forearms
levels: A punch that stuns. Politely.
Break through doors and thin walls.
desc: Standard issue for the municipal demolition squad, which was never founded. The forearms were already paid for.

name: Silent Pistons
levels: Silent footsteps.
High jump: balconies, roofs, the tower's terrace.
desc: Muffled to the legal night-time noise limit of 35 decibels. The jump was a clerical error nobody wanted to correct.

name: Subdermal Plating
levels: Armour under the skin: take twice the punishment.
Camouflage for a few seconds.
desc: Tested on the traffic wardens of Scafati. Keeps the rain out. The camouflage works best against people who were not looking anyway.

name: Municipal Liver
levels: Drink without getting drunk: accept every round in Via di Mezzo.
Alcohol now heals you.
desc: Filters up to forty litres of limoncello an hour. Fitted under the Council's programme for public officials at after-hours social engagements. Hangovers: none. Excuses to leave the bar: also none.

name: Overclocked Heart
levels: Run faster.
A short burst of speed.
desc: Page 94 of the contract, in a font size the Council describes as 'discreet'. The warranty covers everything except cardiac events.

name: Lockpick Toe
levels: Pick locks with your foot while your hands are busy.
Pick them twice as fast.
desc: A master key in the big toe. The Council insists it was designed for 'hands-free access to municipal archives'. Nobody asked why the archives are locked.

name: Compactor Stomach
levels: Swallow objects: more inventory space.
Even more space. Evidence included.
desc: Derived from the Riciclangri collection trucks. Compresses anything to the size of a stock cube. Do not swallow the phone while the Mayor is calling.
